name: qa-auth-flows
description: Authentication flow testing: OAuth 2.0 with PKCE, multi-factor authentication, and session management, plus Keycloak, Auth0 and Okta integration tests. Anchored on RFC 7636, RFC 9700 and OWASP ASVS V3. A critic agent (token-storage-security-critic) flags tokens in localStorage, auth cookies missing httpOnly / Secure / SameSite, and tokens leaking into logs or URLs.
